Census retail sales, 08:30 New York (the calendar is JavaScript-only; the .ics and .json endpoints both return the page shell)

University of Michigan consumer sentiment for 2016-2025 entirely, and most of 2026 — the 10:00 New York time is verified, the dates are not published machine-readably
Weekly unemployment claims on federal-holiday weeks: the release shifts and DOL does not publish the shifted date, so nothing is emitted
